description: React component for verifying OTP during password reset process, including UI elements, OTP handling, and API calls.

methods.name: onCompleted
methods.description: Handles successful OTP send, manages loading state.

methods.name: onError
methods.description: Handles errors during OTP send, sets error message.

methods.name: onCodeFilled
methods.description: Verifies entered OTP against generated OTP, navigates on success.

methods.name: resendOtp
methods.description: Generates a new OTP for resend.

methods.name: handleCode
methods.description: Handles OTP input change, triggers verification when 6 digits entered.

calls: sendOtp({ variables: { email: state?.email, otp: otpFrom } })
